en-US.author: Synheart AI
en-US.description: Developer toolkit for building on the Synheart platform
en-US.longDescription:
The Synheart developer toolkit. Set up app projects and install pinned SDK
artifacts; generate and replay mock wearable data and run the Synheart
platform locally; manage your account, organizations, projects and API keys;
and connect coding agents to Synapse, Synheart Life and the agent guard.
en-US.name: Synheart
